To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a new adaptive HOSM differentiator with varying gains to achieve global/semiglobal exact tracking using only output feedback information for a wide class of nonlinear systems.

(a) the proposed adaptive HOMS differentiator with varying gains can be used to achieve robust exact output feedback tracking of a wider class nonlinear systems with disturbances, parametric uncertainties and input constraints; (b) the proposed adaptive differentiator can be used for the exact tracking control of a wider class systems using only input output measurements, (c) the proposed differentiator can be applied to a variety of different sliding mode controllers such as first order sliding mode, non singular terminal sliding mode control and
the proposed differentiator can be applied in the context of global/semi global exact tracking for a wider class of non-linear systems with parametric uncertainties and disturbances.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a new adaptive HOSM differentiator with varying gains to achieve global robust exact output tracking for a class of nonlinear systems.
a new HOSM differentiator for the exact tracking control of nonlinear systems with parametric uncertainties and disturbances.
the design of a robust exact tracking controller for a class of nonlinear systems using only output information.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all of the proposed control designs are capable to achieve global/semi global robust exact tracking using only the input output information of the system.
the proposed differentiator is capable of handling the most demanding nonlinear systems with parametric uncertainties and disturbances.

, for the same class of systems and under the same assumptions, the proposed HOSM differentiator with adaptive gain outperforms all other differentiators, including the SOSM differentiators, for output feedback exact tracking control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed adaptive HOMSM differentiator is able to achieve global/semi global stability and robust exact tracking in output feedback applications for nonlinear systems with disturbances.
, the proposed differentiator can be used to address the exact control problem of a wider class (nonlinear, uncertain, disturbed) of plants when only input-output information is available.
the proposed adaptive HODM differentiator is able to achieve exact tracking for a wide class of nonlinear systems under output feedback control.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed adaptive differentiator can be used in a wide variety of control designs, which can achieve global robust tracking performance.
the proposed HOSM differentiator with adaptive parameters is robust enough to be used for global/semi global tracking of the complete state of a class of nonlinear systems.

the proposed differentiator is able to achieve robust tracking for a wide range of nonlinear systems using a single design, while previous differentiators require specific designs for each control scheme.
